prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [143].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 143 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: shorten the break by three minutes, because the banner and the sign could both be dealt with sooner
options.zh: 讓換景縮短三分鐘，因為布旗和標牌都能提早處理
options.whyZh: 這些工作不是逐項加總。布旗原本就在臺座就位的時間內收好，讓它更快完成也不會減少觀眾等待。

options.text: leave the break unchanged, because the platform still takes longer than any other job
options.zh: 讓換景長度不變，因為臺座仍比其他每項工作都耗時
options.whyZh: 臺座仍是最久的單一工作，但目前臺座之後還要再花一分鐘裝標牌；夾式標牌取消這段串接等待。

options.text: shorten the break by one minute, even if the banner is folded at the usual speed
options.zh: 即使照平常速度收折布旗，也能讓換景縮短一分鐘
options.whyZh: 舊方式要等臺座三分鐘再加掛標牌一分鐘；新標牌可於移動臺座時同步裝好。收布旗本來就在臺座進行時完成，所以仍可縮短一分鐘。

options.text: shorten the break only if the crew also learns to fold the banner more quickly
options.zh: 只有組員也學會更快收折布旗，才能讓換景縮短
options.whyZh: 收布旗原本就在臺座就位前完成，因此加快布旗並非縮短換景的必要條件。

explanationZh: 舊方式要等臺座三分鐘再加掛標牌一分鐘；新標牌可於移動臺座時同步裝好。收布旗本來就在臺座進行時完成，所以仍可縮短一分鐘。
evidence: If one job is already holding up the next scene, finishing another job during that same interval does not make the audience wait longer. / Attaching the street sign then takes one more minute; the next scene cannot begin until both are ready. / Folding the market banner takes two minutes, entirely within the platform's three minutes. / the sign will need no work afterward.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If one job is already holding up the next scene, finishing another job during that same interval does not make the audience wait longer.
Attaching the street sign then takes one more minute; the next scene cannot begin until both are ready.
Folding the market banner takes two minutes, entirely within the platform's three minutes.
the sign will need no work afterward.

vocabulary.zh: 在臺座作業的三分鐘之內
vocabulary.note: 同步完成的工作不會把等待時間額外加長。
